coverage: All ZIP entries CRC checked; all terrain/entity/POI chunk records structurally validated and NBT decoded; actual block indices decoded, unused palette entries excluded. Missing sections are implicit air, explicit cell count is not total world volume. Semantic deltas count coordinates with changed nonair terrain state arrangement, excluding time/light/entity metadata; they are not individual changed-block counts.
validity_rule: All six archives, CRC/no path errors/no NBT errors and every container chunks==decoded_chunks
